tagline.en_US: Signal is a messaging app with privacy at its core. It is free and easy to use, with strong end-to-end encryption that keeps your communication completely private.

description.en_US: Signal is a privacy-focused messaging application designed for secure communication. It utilizes strong end-to-end encryption to ensure conversations remain completely private between participants. The service allows users to send messages and keep in touch without compromising their personal data.
